_comment: TEAM COMPLETION REWARDS: collect a franchise’s entire 2026-27 roster, earn that team’s reward card. THREE SECTIONS. `migrated` MOVES a card out of Super Season / Rookie / Summer Standouts into this set — it leaves its old set entirely, keeps its original badge, and gains the TEAM REWARD pill above it. `picks` builds a card from scratch for the three franchises nothing sensible could be moved to. `tiers` is the conference and full-set rewards, which are not franchise-bound. WHY MIGRATION. The ladder could not be built any other way: a franchise is hard to collect because its current roster is stacked, and those same franchises have had their history most thoroughly mined by the special sets, so the hardest rosters had the THINNEST fresh candidate pools. Only 3 of the 10 hardest could reach the legendary band from scratch; eight of the ten easiest could offer a better card than the median of the ten hardest. Moving the mined history back into rewards fixes supply without duplicating a single card.

MIA.name: Alonzo Mourning
MIA.bandException: Declared on 2026-09-07 at $860, forty dollars under Miami's super-rare floor; the user, shown the gap: "Mourning is a fun enough card that it seems fine as a reward." His 2005-06 is the Heat's title season and the last real year of a franchise icon; the alternatives price in band but mean nothing to Miami. REFRESHED 2026-09-22: he now prints $1000, INSIDE super-rare ($930-1329) — the reprices since moved him up, so the exception is dormant and kept only so the next drift below the line is a decision already made, not a build failure.

MEM.name: Marc Gasol
MEM.note: His All-NBA year. Replaces his own 2013-14 ($850) after MEM moved up to super-rare on 2026-09-09. $1100 on his real log.

ATL.name: Josh Smith
ATL.bandException: Declared after the 2026-09-12 bench-curve reprice at $850, a hundred dollars under the super-rare floor Atlanta then earned: the reprice moved BOTH sides of the test, and shown the gap and the option to re-pick against real game logs, the user said "just use Smith" - a decision, not a rounding artefact. His 2008-09 is the Josh Smith season Atlanta remembers. REFRESHED 2026-09-22: Atlanta earns RARE now and he prints $840, INSIDE rare ($700-929); the exception is dormant and stays declared for the next time the line moves under him.

TOR.name: Vince Carter
TOR.note: The user, 2026-09-18: "Go with Vince, Wall and Brand." Replaces Anthony Parker 2006-07 after Kawhi Leonard's move to Toronto took TOR from rare to legendary (8th hardest). His 2000-01 is the Super Season capstone and 1998-99 his Rookie card, so 1999-2000 — the dunk-contest year — is the Raptors reward. Priced over the pre-2002 BPM bridge (no dunksandthrees EPM before 2002).
TOR.bandException: Twenty dollars under the legendary floor: $1310 against $1330, the number generateTeamRewards printed on 2026-09-22 (the pre-2002 BPM bridge; it priced $620 with no EPM at all). The user picked him by name on 2026-09-18 — "Go with Vince, Wall and Brand" — knowing NO uncarded Raptors season reaches legendary: Bosh 2010 $1250, Lowry 2017 $1170, Vince 2003 $1160, and his 2000-01 ($1480) is already the Super Season capstone. The same size of exception Philadelphia carries for Erving, declared rather than hidden. Drop this field if a reprice lifts him to $1330.

POR.name: Wesley Matthews
POR.note: Replaces the migrated Lillard 2019-20 ($1340, legendary) after the 2026-09-09 reprice dropped POR to super-rare. $930 on his real log; the user chose him over Whiteside 2019-20 ($1080).

LAC.name: Elton Brand
LAC.note: The user, 2026-09-18: "Go with Vince, Wall and Brand." Brandon Ingram's move to the Clippers took LAC from super-rare to rare (29th), so Zubac's migrated 2024-25 ($1090) went back to Super Season and this is built fresh. His 2005-06 is his Super Season card (legends-2026.json); 2002-03 is the reward, a Throwback by the identity rule.

_excluded.Enes Kanter / Enes Freedom: excluded from this game permanently, by the owner's decision. Do not re-add under either name.

_tierComment: PICKS TARGET THE LOW END OF THEIR BAND, which is what keeps each source set’s marquee card where it is: Curry’s 2015-16, LeBron’s 2008-09, Embiid’s 2021-22 and Gilgeous-Alexander’s 2024-25 all stay in Super Season. THE CONFERENCE ODDITY IS FIXED. The East reward was a Houston card because only Giannis cleared the franchise ceiling from an Eastern team, and he was the capstone. Two moves solved it: Oklahoma City dropped from Gilgeous-Alexander ($1,680) to Paul George ($1,500), lowering the ceiling, and the three tiers are now BUILT from seasons no set holds rather than moved from ones that do. Every tier is conference-correct and above every franchise reward: LeBron’s 2009-10 MVP year for the East, Curry’s 2020-21 for the West, and Giannis’ 2019-20 MVP+DPOY season — $2,030, the best card in the game — for all 348 cards.

PHI.bandException: Dr. J's 1976-77 prints $1290 (2026-09-22; it was $1,180 when this was declared), forty dollars under the legendary floor of $1330. Philadelphia has no off-roster Philly-jersey card above it: Barkley's 1989-90 is $1,160 and everything higher is Joel Embiid, who is ON the 2026-27 roster this reward is for. Forty dollars is not worth rewarding a roster with a better copy of a player already in it.

IND.bandException: Declared after the 2026-09-12 bench-curve reprice, when Indiana earned rare and Turner's 2018-19 landed at $960, eleven dollars over the rare ceiling - one rounding step, smaller than Philadelphia's twenty and Miami's forty. REFRESHED 2026-09-22: Indiana earns SUPER-RARE now and he still prints $960, INSIDE super-rare ($930-1329); the exception is dormant and stays declared for the next time the line moves. Nothing about the pick is wrong; the line moved under it, twice.

WAS.note: The user, 2026-09-18: "Use the best card, if it's a super season, make it as such." Kawhi's move took WAS from legendary to super-rare (11th); Beal's 2020-21 ($1540) became a curated Throwback (card-data/curated-cards-2026.json) and Wall's 2016-17, his best season by the rule, is his Super Season card moved in — exactly as Zubac's was for LAC.
